reader.requirement: At 85, in a report whose RD omits the PAGE clause, every LINE NUMBER clause of every report group (01 or subordinate, any group type) must be relative (LINE PLUS integer-2); an absolute LINE integer-1, with or without ON NEXT PAGE, must be refused, and relative clauses must be accepted and placed by GR4.

edition-consulted.switches: a LINE operand of NEXT PAGE with no integer (the 2002 third alternative) refused below 2002 (COBOL0900, report-line-next-page-2002)
a multiple LINE clause and the LINES/NUMBERS/ARE spellings refused below 2002 (COBOL0900, report-multi-line-2002)
a PAGE clause without its page limit (the 2002 form that leaves a report unpaged though PAGE is written) refused below 2002 (COBOL0900), so at 85 'PAGE written' and 'Paged' coincide

reader.edition-search: The SR5 test itself (!model.Paged && (absolute || NEXT)) in ScreenReportLineClauses consults no edition; model.Paged is set in BindReportDescriptionClauses only when the PAGE clause's integer-1 is written, which the 1985 format always requires.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the relative-only screen is the same code at every edition; at 85 the 2002 forms (bare NEXT PAGE, multiple LINE, PAGE without a limit) are refused in addition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f30_03 exercises the accept side (relative clauses in a DE and an RF of an RD without PAGE); the refusal of absolute clauses is not exercised.

probes.printed: error COBOL2199: RD 'R1': the report is not divided into pages, so all its LINE clauses shall be relative — LINE 3 is absolute
error COBOL2199: ... LINE 3 ON NEXT PAGE is absolute
error COBOL2199: ... LINE 4 is absolute (subordinate entry after a relative line; plus the SR3 order error)
error COBOL2199: ... LINE 1 is absolute (report heading)
error COBOL2199: ... LINE 2 is absolute (report footing, subordinate entry)

probes.expected: accepted: relative LINE with a PAGE clause

probes.printed: error COBOL2199 (LINE 3 absolute, report unpaged) and error COBOL0900: the PAGE clause without its page limit requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: refused: 'PAGE LIMIT 80 COLUMNS' is not a 1985 PAGE clause

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: a LINE operand of NEXT PAGE with no integer requires COBOL-2002

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR5  (3.15.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5

reader.notes: ScreenReportLineClauses walks every written LINE clause of the RD's flat entry array once and refuses an absolute operand (or a NEXT PAGE operand) when the RD is unpaged. The diagnostic cites §2023:13.18.35.3 SR5, the same rule. Runtime placement of relative lines without PAGE is the witness g85_f30_03.

refuter.evidence: Read ReportSectionBinder.ScreenReportLineClauses (the !model.Paged test runs per RD model). Probes at --std 85: Q5TWO (two RDs on one FD: R1 paged with absolute 'LINE NUMBER IS 3', R2 unpaged with 'LINE NUMBER IS PLUS 0', 'LINE PLUS 0', 'LINE PLUS 2') -> compiles and runs, so the paged RD's absolute clause does not leak to the unpaged one; Q5UNP1 (unpaged R1 FIRST, absolute 'LINE IS 3' on a CONTROL FOOTING FINAL group, then a paged R2 with absolute LINE 3) -> COBOL2199 on R1 only. 1985 Table 5 (report footing) marks A R and NP R 'Illegal Combination' when PAGE is omitted, which is the same refusal. Side observation, outside this syntax rule: Q5ONE (single unpaged RD, first group's first clause LINE PLUS 0 at LINE-COUNTER 0) prints LC 3 after the first group, where §1985:XIII.3.10.8 rule 3d (LINE-COUNTER + integer) would give line 0 and LC 2; a line 0 is degenerate, so this is a presentation-rule question for that rule's own record, not this one. cite.py: OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR5  (3.15.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5.
